notes: Opened only AGENTS.md, the role file, the packet and snapshot 6a185dd9954fea49.txt (one Grep on that exact path); no protocol violation. Judgement calls: Koszt#2.1 ('Dostępne rozwiązania różnią się kosztem') filed as editorial_estimate because it is the Koszt field and states no figure or product; the snapshot only says tools are 'darmowe' (line 479) and a hardware key is an extra cost (line 461) and gives no price comparison of managers, so if a reviewer treats it as a source_claim it would be partly. W praktyce#3.1 ('Zacznij od poczty') is marked fully backed because the source says to enable 2FA 'przede wszystkim' on key accounts with mail first and gives the reset-gateway reason, but it never states an explicit order of work.
